name: Juno
self_text: I am an Egyptian woman in my mid 30s with a background in economics. Outside of my studies, I love climbing because it keeps me active and focused. Right now, I am focusing on programming. A typical session for me is a step-by-step walkthrough where I can talk things through as we go, as I do best when someone explains things to me. I am happy to do this online, and most weeks I am available on Saturday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with occasional short exchanges or talking things through as we go. I'd strongly prefer that you are into a step-by-step walkthrough session, though it's not a requirement. It would matter a lot if you are available Saturday afternoon, but I won't rule you out over it. It would be nice if you are the one who explains the material to me.
